zh.principle: **协议**：NSEC3 哈希化否定证明（NSEC3）。RFC 5155 §3 定义该资源记录：「The NSEC3 Resource Record (RR) provides authenticated denial of existence for DNS Resource Record Sets.」它回答`某名称/类型不存在`这一命题，并带上签名。
zh.why: 动机是旧记录的副作用：§1.1 说明「Though the NSEC RR meets the requirements for authenticated denial of existence, it introduces a side-effect in that the contents of a zone can be enumerated.」§3 的对策是改用哈希名：「To provide protection against zone enumeration, the owner names used in the NSEC3 RR are cryptographic hashes of the original owner name prepended as a single label to the name of the zone.」
zh.used: 三个参数决定行为：迭代次数「defines the number of additional times the hash function has been performed」并换取对字典攻击的韧性；盐值「is appended to the original owner name before hashing in order to defend against pre-calculated dictionary attacks」；Opt-Out 标志则「If the Opt-Out flag is set, the NSEC3 record covers zero or more unsigned delegations.」
zh.broken: 它提高成本而非消除风险：§12.1.1 承认「The NSEC3 RRs are still susceptible to dictionary attacks」，并建议「The salt SHOULD be at least 64 bits long and unpredictable」且定期更换；§12.1.2 指出哈希碰撞时「it will be impossible to prove the non-existence of the colliding QNAME」。哈希算法只有 SHA-1 一种被定义。
zh.history:
RFC 5155 于 2008 年 3 月发布为 Standards Track（作者 Laurie、Sisson、Arends、Blacka），头部既无 Obsoletes 也无 Updates 行；摘要说明它是「an alternative resource record, NSEC3」，在保持认证否定的同时「provides measures against zone enumeration and permits gradual expansion of delegation-centric zones」，NSEC3 的类型号为 50。

en.principle: **Protocol**: NSEC3 (NSEC3 哈希化否定证明). Section 3 defines the record: "The NSEC3 Resource Record (RR) provides authenticated denial of existence for DNS Resource Record Sets." It answers the claim that a name or type is absent, signed like the rest of DNSSEC.
en.why: The motive is a side effect of the older record: §1.1 says "Though the NSEC RR meets the requirements for authenticated denial of existence, it introduces a side-effect in that the contents of a zone can be enumerated." Section 3 answers with hashed names: "To provide protection against zone enumeration, the owner names used in the NSEC3 RR are cryptographic hashes of the original owner name prepended as a single label to the name of the zone."
en.used:
Three parameters set the behaviour. Iterations "defines the number of additional times the hash function has been performed", buying resilience against dictionary attacks; the salt "is appended to the original owner name before hashing in order to defend against pre-calculated dictionary attacks"; and "If the Opt-Out flag is set, the NSEC3 record covers zero or more unsigned delegations."

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken: Cost is raised, not risk removed: §12.1.1 concedes "The NSEC3 RRs are still susceptible to dictionary attacks", advising that "The salt SHOULD be at least 64 bits long and unpredictable" and be changed regularly; §12.1.2 notes that on a collision "it will be impossible to prove the non-existence of the colliding QNAME". SHA-1 is the only hash algorithm defined.
en.history: RFC 5155 is a March 2008 Standards Track document (Laurie, Sisson, Arends and Blacka) with neither an Obsoletes nor an Updates line. The abstract presents NSEC3 as "an alternative resource record" that keeps authenticated denial while it "provides measures against zone enumeration and permits gradual expansion of delegation-centric zones"; its type number is 50.

zh: 认证否定：证明某名称或类型不存在。
区域枚举：把区内所有名称列出的行为。
哈希所有者名：把原名哈希后作为单标签前置。
Salt：加在原名后一起哈希的随机值。
Opt-Out：覆盖未签名委托的简化模式。
en: Authenticated denial: proving a name or type does not exist.
Zone enumeration: listing every name in a zone.
Hashed owner name: the original name hashed into one label.
Iterations: extra rounds of the hash function.
Salt: a random value hashed with the owner name.
Opt-Out: the simplified coverage of unsigned delegations.
